title: Smart Decision
description: Guards a task when the primary model stops unexpectedly or hands a decision to the user. Rules run first; the bypass model is used only when rules cannot decide safely.

mode.label: Guard mode
mode.ruleOnlyHint: Uses no model. It can recover retryable faults and choose the first safe explicit option; permissions, credentials, purchases, and destructive choices always wait for a person.
mode.rulePlusModelHint: Runs the same deterministic rules first. Only unresolved open questions or ambiguous choices are sent to the bypass model with bounded context.

interventionReason.tool_stalled_safety_halt: A tool stopped progressing; waiting for a person to avoid duplicate effects
interventionReason.model_stalled: The primary model exceeded the silence threshold outside a tool
interventionReason.recovery_limit_reached: Provider-fault recovery reached its retry limit
interventionReason.provider_fault_detected: A recoverable provider, network, or rate-limit fault was detected
interventionReason.sensitive_input_required: Credentials, payment, or permission input requires a person
interventionReason.rule_selected_safe_option: The rule guard selected the first safe option
interventionReason.bypass_model_decision: Rules were inconclusive; the bypass model returned a constrained decision
interventionReason.bypass_model_halted: The bypass model stopped and requested human input
interventionReason.bypass_model_failed: The bypass model could not produce a constrained decision
interventionReason.rule_cannot_answer: The rule guard cannot safely answer this open question
interventionReason.destructive_answer_rejected: A destructive candidate answer was rejected

validation.noChatModel: No chat model is available for bypass decisions
